title: Budget Act funds C2C planning
detail: 2019 Budget Act (SB 75) funds a planning process for a statewide longitudinal data system, facilitated by WestEd.

title: Master Plan for Early Learning and Care
detail: Calls for integrated early childhood data. Same month: first C2C legislative report.

title: AB 132 establishes C2C
detail: Education Code 10850-10875 creates the system and the Office of Cradle-to-Career Data in GovOps. Child care programs move from CDE to CDSS (AB 131).

title: AB 133 creates the CalHHS Data Exchange Framework
detail: Health and Safety Code 130290.

title: CalKIDS newborn accounts begin
detail: Every child born on or after July 1, 2022 gets a seeded account. Universal TK rollout begins in 2022-23.

title: First C2C data submissions
detail: Eight initial data partners submit data in 2023.

title: DDS joins C2C
detail: Resolution 24-02 adds Developmental Services data, including Early Start.

title: CAPSDAC required for LEA-run state preschool
detail: Education Code 60910 child, classroom and staff data.

title: ScholarShare (CalKIDS) joins C2C
detail: Resolution 25-01.

title: Student Pathways Dashboard launches
detail: First public C2C tool, announced April 22, 2025.

title: Largest C2C expansion: workforce data
detail: Board approves LWDA labor and training data, with CWDB and ETP as new partners and apprenticeship data from DAS.

title: AB 2092 (ECIDS) held in Appropriations
detail: Would have created an ECIDS under CDSS linked to C2C.

title: New EDD data points approved
detail: Employer ID and name among new P20W points; EDD moves to Snowflake transfer.

title: SB 135 higher education trailer bill
detail: Chapter 79, Statutes of 2026. Requires partner MOUs for data sharing and requests UC participation.

title: C2C five-year mark: 16 data partners
detail: Up from 8 partners submitting data in 2023.

title: C2C 2026-31 Strategic Plan and 2026-27 Work Plan
detail: Transfer outcomes and teacher dashboards; initial milestones for early learning and care data import.

title: SB 1054 (enhanced wage records) held
detail: Held in Assembly Appropriations.

title: AB 1534 Workforce Pell oversight signed
detail: Reported chaptered September 27, 2026. Creates a state approval process for Workforce Pell programs.

title: CDE announces CDMIS 2.0
detail: CDMIS Monthly Report replaces the 801A beginning July 2027.

title: D4TP letter on Early Learning Data Task Force
detail: Coalition letter considered for the November 13 C2C Governing Board meeting.
